Wonderful lunch buffet experience
Aug 2026 • Friends
Heard many reviews about Lavela Buffet and just experienced the lunch buffet.
Surprisingly, the lunch buffet is quite affordable, I thought it wouldn't be good, but the buffet has a lot of seafood. 
Abalone, sea snails, super large freshwater prawns, crab, blood cockles, freshwater snails, oysters, clams, pearl clams, and other dishes are all delicious.
The friendly staff members are excellent.
 Payment with VP Bank card also gets an extra 10% discount.
Thank you very much to the restaurant team.

Oct 2023 • Friends
I've heard this restaurant is famous in Saigon. Coming here today, I can eat many dishes from close and familiar dishes such as: salad, salad to high-end seafood dishes like lobster, abalone...
